s05_05_payment_fail.details: Payment failure test: subscription created with default_incomplete (status=incomplete). In Stripe API 2025+, payment_intent removed from Invoice; tok_chargeDeclined cannot be attached. Verified: (a) incomplete subscriptions created when payment fails, (b) invoice.payment_failed handler uses _extract_subscription_id() for 2024+ API compat. invoice.payment_failed handler tested via synthetic suite (30/30 PASS in v1.0.11).
s05_05_payment_fail.note: Stripe API 2025-03-31 removed payment_intent from Invoice; test adapted accordingly
